# Studio CAVA

> Architecture and interior design studio in Costa Rica, formerly AVARQ. Houses, rental villas, small hotels, cafés, hangars and master plans, mostly on the Guanacaste coast, from the study of the lot to the permits and the supervision of the works. 42 projects since 2015, 35 of them in Guanacaste.

Contact: hola@cava.design, WhatsApp +506 7173 7336. Spanish pages live under https://cava.design/es/.

## Projects

- [Project index](https://cava.design/projects/index/): all 42 projects with type, place, built area, year and stage
- [Project index, CSV](https://cava.design/projects/index.csv)
- [Projects with images](https://cava.design/projects/)
- [Rancho Cartagena](https://cava.design/projects/rancho-cartagena/): house, Rancho Cartagena, Guanacaste
- [Papagayo 404](https://cava.design/projects/papagayo-404/): house extension, Península Papagayo, Guanacaste
- [Casa Alcaraván](https://cava.design/projects/casa-alcaravan/): house, Playa Grande, Guanacaste
- [Hangars B](https://cava.design/projects/hangars-b/): hangars, Huacas, Guanacaste
- [Tragaluz Retreat](https://cava.design/projects/tragaluz-retreat/): hotel, Playa Negra, Guanacaste
- [Kauhane House](https://cava.design/projects/kauhane-house/): house, Playa Grande, Guanacaste
- [Negra Mixed Use](https://cava.design/projects/negra-mixed-use/): mixed use, Playa Negra, Guanacaste
- [S3 Houses](https://cava.design/projects/s3-houses/): houses, Playa Langosta, Guanacaste
- [Tree House](https://cava.design/projects/tree-house/): tree house, Las Ventanas, Playa Grande
- [Green City, Amacor](https://cava.design/projects/green-city-amacor/): house, Green City, San Rafael
- [Dawn Patrol Bakery](https://cava.design/projects/dawn-patrol-bakery/): bakery and café, Tamarindo, Guanacaste
- [La Perla](https://cava.design/projects/la-perla/): condominium master plan, Matapalo, Santa Cruz
- [Military Museum](https://cava.design/projects/military-museum/): museum, Isola della Maddalena, Sardinia
- [Lean & Green](https://cava.design/projects/lean-and-green/): restaurant and grocery, La Jolla, San Diego
